claude_proposed_widenings.name: ActivatedAbilityMechanics.activationWindow = start_of_self_turn
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The feature is only activatable in a specific turn window, not as a generic free activation on the monk's turn.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "At the start of your turn, you can expend 3 Focus Points"

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ActivationResource.external_pool_spend
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The feature spends 3 points from the monk's shared Focus Point pool. Current resources model only feature-owned use counts or charge pools with their own caps and reset cadence, which would duplicate or misstate the underlying resource.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: DurationEndTrigger.target_has_condition
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The effect ends early when the beneficiary gains a specific condition. Current early-end triggers cover damage, attack, spellcasting, and donning armor, but not condition-gain termination.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "for 1 minute or until you have the Incapacitated condition"
